data.title: Mechanochemical engineering of chiroptical properties in indium-based chiral metal halides by grinding
data.author: Junhong Wu, Hao Li, Jialu Wang, Xiaorui Yang, Tianyong Zhang, Bin Li, Shuang Jiang
data.summary: Nanomaterials with chiral photoluminescence are promising candidates for advanced optical technologies. Here, the authors use mechsanochemical processing to tune the emission of circularly polarized light and enhance the nonlinear optical response in indium-based halides.
data.title_cn: 通过研磨研究铟基手性金属卤化物手性光学性质的机械化学工程
data.abstract_cn: 具有手性光致发光的纳米材料是先进光学技术的有希望的候选材料。在这里，作者使用机械化学处理来调节圆偏振光的发射并增强铟基卤化物的非线性光学响应。

data.title: Record-breaking Greenland ice sheet melt events under recent and future climate
data.author: Josep Bonsoms, Sergi González-Herrero, Xavier Fettweis, Marc Lemus-Cánovas, Marc Oliva, Juan I. López-Moreno
data.summary: Abstract The Greenland Ice Sheet (GrIS) has experienced a strong intensification of summer surface melting, with extreme events becoming more frequent, extensive, and severe. Despite its importance for global sea-level rise, the mechanisms driving these extremes remain incompletely understood. We analyze extreme melting events over 1950–2023 using an analog-based framework combined with a regional climate model to disentangle thermodynamic and dynamic contributions. Thermodynamic processes intensify meltwater production by 25% relative to 1950–1975 when circulation analog events are included, increasing to 63% when circulation-analog events are included, with the strongest increases in northern Greenland. Seven of the ten most extreme events occurred after 2000, with meltwater anomalies reaching up to three times their synoptic average. Record-breaking events such as August 2012, July 2019, and July 2021 show no dynamic precedents. Future projections under high-emission scenarios suggest that extreme meltwater anomalies could increase by up to +372% by 2100 (SSP5-8.5, CMIP6), highlighting the profound impact of climate change on GrIS melt extremes.
data.title_cn: 近期和未来气候下破纪录的格陵兰冰盖融化事件
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 格陵兰冰盖（GrIS）经历了夏季表面融化的强烈加剧，极端事件变得更加频繁、广泛和严重。尽管它对全球海平面上升很重要，但导致这些极端现象的机制仍不完全清楚。我们使用基于模拟的框架与区域气候模型相结合来分析 1950-2023 年的极端融化事件，以理清热力学和动力学的贡献。当包括环流模拟事件时，热力学过程使融水产量比 1950-1975 年增加了 25%，当包括环流模拟事件时，融水产量增加到 63%，其中格陵兰岛北部的增幅最强。十次最极端的事件中有七次发生在 2000 年之后，融水异常达到天气平均值的三倍。 2012 年 8 月、2019 年 7 月和 2021 年 7 月等破纪录事件没有先例。高排放情景下的未来预测表明，到 2100 年，极端融水异常可能增加高达 +372%（SSP5-8.5，CMIP6），凸显了气候变化对 GrIS 融水极端事件的深远影响。

data.title: Bioactive lipid-mediated structural and functional regulation of the essential human potassium channel Kir7.1
data.author: Qingwei Niu, Simon Vu, Yuanjiang Xu, Mingxing Qian, Anastasiia Rudenko, Jin Ye, Jianwei Zeng, Wei Huang, Douglas F. Covey, Rui Zhang, Ziao Fu, Polina V. Lishko
data.summary: Abstract The inwardly rectifying potassium channel Kir7.1 is essential for the physiological function of diverse tissues, including the retinal pigment epithelium and the gestational myometrium. Loss-of-function mutations in KCNJ13 , which encodes Kir7.1, or conditional ablation of Kir7.1 in the retinal pigment epithelium, lead to early-onset vision loss. Despite strong genetic evidence supporting Kir7.1 as a therapeutic target, its regulation by endogenous ligands—beyond phosphoinositides—remains poorly understood. Here, we report cryo-electron microscopy structures of human Kir7.1 in multiple functional states at resolutions ranging from 2.8 Å to 4.0 Å. These structures uncover the molecular basis of Kir7.1 modulation by PI 4,5 P 2 , its selectivity, rectification, and identify a distinct steroid-binding site that may mediate cooperative channel gating. Our data suggest that endogenous cholesterol acts as an inhibitory ligand, which is displaced by select activating steroids. These activating steroids work in concert with PI 4,5 P 2 to promote channel opening through profound changes in cytoplasmic domains, and the linker region. Electrophysiological analyses define a pharmacological landscape of Kir7.1 activators, providing innovative tools to probe and modulate channel function in both physiological and pathological contexts.
data.title_cn: 生物活性脂质介导的人体必需钾通道 Kir7.1 的结构和功能调节
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 内向整流钾通道 Kir7.1 对于多种组织的生理功能至关重要，包括视网膜色素上皮和妊娠子宫肌层。编码 Kir7.1 的 KCNJ13 的功能丧失突变，或视网膜色素上皮细胞中 Kir7.1 的条件性消融，会导致早发性视力丧失。尽管有强有力的遗传证据支持 Kir7.1 作为治疗靶点，但除磷酸肌醇之外的内源配体对它的调节仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们报告了人类 Kir7.1 在多种功能状态下的冷冻电子显微镜结构，分辨率范围为 2.8 Å 至 4.0 Å。这些结构揭示了 PI 4,5 P 2 调节 Kir7.1 的分子基础、其选择性、整流性，并确定了可能介导协作通道门控的独特类固醇结合位点。我们的数据表明，内源性胆固醇充当抑制性配体，它被选择性的激活类固醇取代。这些激活类固醇与 PI 4,5 P 2 协同作用，通过细胞质结构域和连接区的深刻变化促进通道开放。电生理学分析定义了 Kir7.1 激活剂的药理学景观，提供了在生理和病理环境下探测和调节通道功能的创新工具。

data.title: Resonance fluorescence and indistinguishable photons from a coherently driven B centre in hBN
data.author: Domitille Gérard, Stéphanie Buil, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Jean-Pierre Hermier, Aymeric Delteil
data.summary: Single-photon sources in van der Waals materials offer new perspectives of integration for quantum information applications. Here, the authors implement resonance fluorescence of a single colour centre in hBN, a quantum optics regime that simultaneously allows for emitter coherent control and generation of indistinguishable photons.
data.title_cn: 来自 hBN 中相干驱动 B 中心的共振荧光和难以区分的光子
data.abstract_cn: 范德华材料中的单光子源为量子信息应用的集成提供了新的视角。在这里，作者在 hBN 中实现了单色中心的共振荧光，这是一种量子光学机制，可以同时实现发射器相干控制和产生不可区分的光子。

data.title: Photochemical thiocarbonyl difluoride generation enables azetidine synthesis
data.author: Ricardo I. Rodríguez, Julien Paut, Giona Armellin, Stefano Visentini, Gabriel Cormier, Federico Droghetti, Mirco Natali, Marco Bortolus, Giorgio Pelosi, Luca Dell’ Amico
data.summary: The activation of amines into thiocarbamoyl fluorides provides access to valuable nitrogen-based functionalities. Here, the authors report a mild, photochemical method for in-situ generation of thiocarbonyl difluoride from N-trifluoromethylthiophthalimide using visible light and organic reductants, and apply this strategy to the synthesis of azetidines from strained azabicyclo[1.1.0]butanes.
data.title_cn: 光化学生成硫代羰基二氟化物能够合成氮杂环丁烷
data.abstract_cn: 将胺活化为硫代氨基甲酰氟提供了获得有价值的氮基官能团的途径。在这里，作者报告了一种温和的光化学方法，使用可见光和有机还原剂从 N-三氟甲基硫代邻苯二甲酰亚胺原位生成硫代羰基二氟化物，并将该策略应用于从应变氮杂双环[1.1.0]丁烷合成氮杂环丁烷。

data.title: Active pixel power control for crosstalk-free All-optical neural interrogation
data.author: Gewei Yan, Guangnan Tian, Yiming Fu, Yingzhu He, Zhentao She, Kenny K. Y. Chen, Julie L. Semmelhack, Jianan Y. Qu
data.summary: This paper presents an active pixel power control (APPC) to minimize crosstalk in all-optical neural interrogation. Tested in vivo, APPC suppresses optogenetic artifacts while preserving Ca2+ imaging quality, enabling precise neural circuit analysis.
data.title_cn: 用于无串扰全光神经询问的主动像素功率控制
data.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种主动像素功率控制（APPC），以最大限度地减少全光神经询问中的串扰。经过体内测试，APPC 可抑制光遗传学伪影，同时保持 Ca2+ 成像质量，从而实现精确的神经回路分析。

data.title: A self-regulated photothermal anti-/deicing film for all-season applications
data.author: Jiayu Du, Wenqi Wang, Yang Fu, Xin Li, Jie Tan, Hao Li, Xu Chen, Fuqiang Chu, Qi Min, Chi Yan Tso
data.summary: Abstract Ice accumulation poses a significant threat to aviation safety and energy infrastructure. Photothermal superhydrophobic surfaces offer a promising anti-/deicing strategy; however, their excessive heat absorption in summer accelerates material degradation and exacerbates urban heat island effects, highlighting the urgent need for dynamic thermal regulation. In this study, we present a self-regulated photothermal storage superhydrophobic film with a trilayer design, comprising a photothermal phase-change base layer, a freeze-resistant thermochromic hydrogel interlayer, and a transparent superhydrophobic top layer. This multifunctional design enables seasonal adaptability, achieving 92% solar absorptance for efficient anti-/deicing in winter and 62% solar modulation to mitigate overheating in summer. This dual mode prolongs freezing time by 10-fold at −20 °C and lowers surface temperature by up to 17 °C in hot weather, demonstrating substantial potential for global building energy-savings. Additionally, its ultraviolet-blocking capability and durable superhydrophobicity ensure long-term durability performance in harsh environments. This work not only addresses the critical overheating challenge in photothermal materials but also advances the development of next-generation anti-icing systems.
data.title_cn: 适合全季节应用的自调节光热防/除冰膜
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 积冰对航空安全和能源基础设施构成重大威胁。光热超疏水表面提供了一种有前景的防冰/除冰策略；然而，它们在夏季过度吸热会加速材料降解并加剧城市热岛效应，凸显了动态热调节的迫切需要。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种具有三层设计的自调节光热存储超疏水薄膜，包括光热相变基层、抗冻热致变色水凝胶夹层和透明超疏水顶层。这种多功能设计可实现季节性适应性，实现 92% 的太阳能吸收率，在冬季实现高效防冰/除冰，并实现 62% 的太阳能调节，以缓解夏季过热。这种双重模式可在-20°C时将结冰时间延长10倍，并在炎热天气下将表面温度降低高达17°C，展现出全球建筑节能的巨大潜力。此外，其紫外线阻挡能力和持久的超疏水性确保了在恶劣环境下的长期耐用性能。这项工作不仅解决了光热材料中关键的过热挑战，而且还推动了下一代防冰系统的开发。

data.title: The ecological role of Pholas dactylus (Mollusca, Bivalvia) empty burrows
data.author: Teo Marrocco, Martina Coppari, Carlo Cerrano, Chiara Gregorin, Torcuato Pulido Mantas, Camilla Roveta, Stefania Puce, Barbara Calcinai
data.summary: The study of biological rhythms has been widely explored in terrestrial and marine systems. Time-lapse photography can document species behaviour, avoiding observer disturbance, and record abundance and interactions. The present work aims to assess the role of the rock-boring bivalve Pholas dactylus Linnaeus, 1758 as a habitat former in the Conero Riviera, documenting the behaviour of the species associated with the common piddock and its burrows. The scan method approach was used to record two behaviours along 6 days of recording: Burrow Interaction (BI) and No Interaction (NI). A total of 34 taxa belonging to 5 phyla were identified, each one represented by one class: Gastropoda, Polychaeta, Malacostraca, Echinoidea and Teleostei. BI data were mainly related to standing on top of burrows, entering or leaving the burrows, or digging to keep it clean, with Gastropoda, Malacostraca and Teleostei displaying distinct activity patterns. The use of video monitoring enabled the analysis of species activity across diel cycles, highlighting the ecological value of the burrows created by P. dactylus and its role as an ecosystem engineer. This also provided new insights into the behavioural dynamics of benthic organisms associated with cryptic habitats.
data.title_cn: 软体动物、双壳纲）空洞的生态作用
data.abstract_cn: 生物节律的研究已在陆地和海洋系统中得到广泛探索。延时摄影可以记录物种行为，避免观察者干扰，并记录丰度和相互作用。目前的工作旨在评估钻岩双壳类 Pholas dactylus Linnaeus（1758 年）作为 Conero Riviera 栖息地形成者的作用，记录与常见的 piddock 及其洞穴相关的物种的行为。使用扫描法方法记录了 6 天记录中的两种行为：洞穴互动 (BI) 和无互动 (NI)。共鉴定出属于 5 个门的 34 个类群，每个类群代表一纲：腹足纲、多毛纲、软甲纲、海胆总纲和硬骨纲。 BI数据主要与站在洞穴顶部、进入或离开洞穴或挖掘以保持洞穴清洁有关，腹足纲、软甲纲和硬骨纲表现出不同的活动模式。视频监控的使用可以分析整个昼夜循环中的物种活动，突显了指雉创造的洞穴的生态价值及其作为生态系统工程师的作用。这也为与神秘栖息地相关的底栖生物的行为动力学提供了新的见解。

data.title: Gaussian-Haar transform fusion enhances DEIM for pomegranate maturity detection
data.author: Yuying Wang, Songzuo Liu, Pingping Hao, Wenxiu Liu, Keke Zhao
data.summary: Automated pomegranate maturity detection facilitates yield enhancement and cost reduction; however, existing methods face significant challenges in complex natural environments, including difficulty in distinguishing green pomegranates from green foliage backgrounds and the trade-off between detection accuracy and computational efficiency. To address these issues, this paper proposes GLMF-DEIM, a lightweight pomegranate maturity detection algorithm. The proposed method is built upon the DEIM detection framework and incorporates a Gaussian-Haar Discrete Wavelet Transform module (GHDWStem) to achieve frequency-domain feature separation, effectively resolving the target-background similarity problem. The approach de-signs a Lightweight Adaptive Weight Downsampling module (LAWD) and Lightweight Frequency-Domain Dynamic Convolution Stages (LFDStages) to enable efficient feature extraction. Additionally, a Multi-level Feature Fusion Network (MFFN) is constructed to enhance multi-scale detection capabilities, while Dense O2O matching strategy and Matchability-Aware Loss are employed to optimize the training process. Extensive validation was conducted on a self-constructed datasets comprising 5,855 images that span five distinct growth stages of pomegranates. The proposed GLMF-DEIM model attains a 50% intersection-over-union (IoU) average precision (AP50) of 93.1%, an AP75 of 84.5%, and a small-object AP (APS) of 32.7%. These results correspond to relative improvements of 1.9%, 2.3%, and 1.3%, respectively, over the performance of the optimal baseline method. In terms of computational efficiency, GLMF-DEIM incurs only 16.9 GFLOPs of computational cost with 8.16 M parameters, achieving an effective trade-off between detection accuracy and inference efficiency that is well-suited for edge deployment scenarios in smart agriculture.
data.title_cn: 高斯-哈尔变换融合增强 DEIM 用于石榴成熟度检测
data.abstract_cn: 石榴成熟度自动化检测，有利于提高产量、降低成本；然而，现有方法在复杂的自然环境中面临重大挑战，包括难以区分绿色石榴和绿色树叶背景以及检测精度和计算效率之间的权衡。针对这些问题，本文提出了一种轻量级石榴成熟度检测算法GLMF-DEIM。该方法建立在DEIM检测框架之上，并结合高斯-哈尔离散小波变换模块（GHDWStem）实现频域特征分离，有效解决目标背景相似性问题。该方法设计了轻量级自适应权重下采样模块（LAWD）和轻量级频域动态卷积阶段（LFDStages）以实现高效的特征提取。此外，还构建了多级特征融合网络（MFFN）来增强多尺度检测能力，同时采用密集O2O匹配策略和Matchability-Aware Loss来优化训练过程。对自行构建的数据集进行了广泛的验证，该数据集包含 5,855 张图像，涵盖石榴的五个不同生长阶段。所提出的 GLMF-DEIM 模型实现了 50% 交集（IoU）平均精度（AP50）为 93.1%，AP75 为 84.5%，小目标 AP（APS）为 32.7%。与最佳基线方法相比，这些结果分别相对提高了 1.9%、2.3% 和 1.3%。在计算效率方面，GLMF-DEIM在816M参数下的计算成本仅为16.9GFLOPs，实现了检测精度和推理效率之间的有效权衡，非常适合智慧农业的边缘部署场景。

data.title: Role of atomic force microscopy in characterization of heterotypic cancer spheroids and their interaction with microplastic particles
data.author: Tatjana Kolesnik, Kristin Öhlinger, Markus Absenger-Novak, Claudia Meindl, Eleonore Fröhlich
data.summary: Whereas the size and shape of spheroids are routinely measured, information about their mechanical properties is often lacking. This study aimed to evaluate the role of atomic force microscopy in characterizing heterotypic cancer spheroids and their interaction with microplastic particles. We examined spheroids composed of fibroblasts, THP-1-derived macrophages, and six different lung cancer cell lines. Spheroids were assessed for viability, proliferation, surface morphology, regional cell distribution, and Young’s modulus (YM). Finally, interactions between spheroids and microplastic particles were investigated under static and dynamic exposure conditions. Morphology and cell segregation differed among spheroids, and we observed significant differences in YM. We found correlations between spheroid YM and lung cancer cell doubling times, between YM measured in the presence and absence of microplastic particles, and between spheroid sizes with and without THP-1 macrophages. Uptake of microplastic particles under dynamic conditions was low, and no clear relationship with YM was apparent. Determination of YM proved to be a useful additional parameter for characterizing cancer spheroids; however, more quantitative methods for measuring particle uptake are needed to define the role of YM in particle–spheroid interactions.
data.title_cn: 原子力显微镜在异型癌症球体表征及其与微塑料颗粒相互作用中的作用
data.abstract_cn: 尽管球体的尺寸和形状是常规测量的，但通常缺乏有关其机械性能的信息。本研究旨在评估原子力显微镜在表征异型癌症球体及其与微塑料颗粒的相互作用中的作用。我们检查了由成纤维细胞、THP-1 衍生的巨噬细胞和六种不同的肺癌细胞系组成的球体。评估球体的活力、增殖、表面形态、区域细胞分布和杨氏模量 (YM)。最后，在静态和动态暴露条件下研究了球体和微塑料颗粒之间的相互作用。球体之间的形态和细胞分离不同，我们观察到 YM 存在显着差异。我们发现球体 YM 与肺癌细胞倍增时间之间、在存在和不存在微塑料颗粒的情况下测量的 YM 之间以及在有和没有 THP-1 巨噬细胞的球体大小之间存在相关性。动态条件下微塑料颗粒的吸收量较低，与 YM 没有明显的关系。 YM 的测定被证明是表征癌症球体的有用的附加参数；然而，需要更多定量方法来测量颗粒吸收，以确定 YM 在颗粒与球体相互作用中的作用。

data.title: In vivo visualization of cardiac extracellular adenosine dynamics and its pharmacological modulation in zebrafish heart failure models
data.author: Phurpa Phurpa, Magdeline E. Carrasco Apolinario, Ryohei Umeda, Shinichiro Kume, Hitoshi Teranishi, Nobuyuki Shimizu, Mengting Shan, Kenshiro Shikano, Tatsuki Kurokawa, Takatoshi Hikida, Toshikatsu Hanada, Yulong Li, Reiko Hanada
data.summary: Heart failure (HF) remains a major clinical challenge with poor prognosis despite extensive research and established treatments. Extracellular ATP and adenosine (Ado), as damage-associated molecular patterns (DAMPs), contribute to HF pathogenesis through pro-inflammatory effects. However, in vivo evidence of ATP/Ado dynamics in failing hearts remains elusive. In this study, we investigated the spatiotemporal dynamics of extracellular Ado in a zebrafish HF model using a genetically encoded heart-specific extracellular Ado sensor (GRABAdo). Terfenadine-induced HF zebrafish showed increased extracellular cardiac Ado, indirectly reflecting elevated extracellular ATP release. These findings demonstrate a strong correlation between extracellular ATP/Ado dynamics and HF progression. Furthermore, pharmacological inhibition of vesicular nucleotide transporter (VNUT), a key regulator of ATP vesicle exocytosis, reduced extracellular ATP/Ado levels and ameliorated cardiac dysfunction in the HF model. Co-treatment with a VNUT inhibitor and purinergic modulators showed additive therapeutic effects. Thus, this study aimed to provide in vivo evidence linking extracellular ATP/Ado signaling to HF pathophysiology and highlight VNUT as a novel therapeutic target for HF. Given the multifactorial nature of HF and the limited success of current anti-inflammatory strategies, targeting purinergic signaling through VNUT inhibition offers a promising approach for managing inflammatory mechanisms in HF.
data.title_cn: 斑马鱼心力衰竭模型中心脏细胞外腺苷动力学的体内可视化及其药理调节
data.abstract_cn: 尽管进行了广泛的研究和成熟的治疗方法，心力衰竭（HF）仍然是一个主要的临床挑战，预后不良。细胞外 ATP 和腺苷 (Ado) 作为损伤相关分子模式 (DAMP)，通过促炎作用促进心力衰竭的发病机制。然而，衰竭心脏中 ATP/Ado 动力学的体内证据仍然难以捉摸。在这项研究中，我们使用基因编码的心脏特异性细胞外 Ado 传感器 (GRABAdo) 研究了斑马鱼 HF 模型中细胞外 Ado 的时空动态。特非那定诱导的 HF 斑马鱼显示细胞外心脏 Ado 增加，间接反映细胞外 ATP 释放增加。这些发现表明细胞外 ATP/Ado 动力学与心力衰竭进展之间存在很强的相关性。此外，对囊泡核苷酸转运蛋白 (VNUT)（ATP 囊泡胞吐作用的关键调节因子）进行药理学抑制，可降低细胞外 ATP/Ado 水平，并改善心力衰竭模型中的心脏功能障碍。 VNUT 抑制剂和嘌呤能调节剂联合治疗显示出附加的治疗效果。因此，本研究旨在提供将细胞外 ATP/Ado 信号传导与心力衰竭病理生理学联系起来的体内证据，并强调 VNUT 作为心力衰竭的新治疗靶点。鉴于心力衰竭的多因素性质以及当前抗炎策略的成功有限，通过 VNUT 抑制来靶向嘌呤能信号为管理心力衰竭炎症机制提供了一种有前景的方法。

data.title: Lanthanide–carbamazepine complexes: synthesis, spectroscopic characterization, DFT Insights, molecular docking, and biological evaluation
data.author: Nora S. Mohamed, Mahmoud M. A. Mohamed, Mohamed R. Shehata, Ehab M. Abdalla
data.summary: Abstract This work focuses on the synthesis of four novel lanthanide complexes: La (III), Ce (III), Nd (III), and Dy (III) with carbamazepine (CBZ). The geometric structural and bonding mode of synthesized complexes were accomplished by various analytical and spectroscopic techniques and the data reveal that the novel complexes have a 1:2 (Ln 3+ :CBZ) electrolytes with general formula [Ln(CBZ) 2 (H 2 O)Cl]Cl 2 .H 2 O and molecular weight: 753.83, 791.07, 777.19 and 777.43 for Ln 3+ complexes respectively. The spectral studies investigated that CBZ interacts as a bidentate ligand via the amide group’s nitrogen and oxygen atoms in its moiety, and the geometric octahedral structure was confirmed by density function theory. On the other hand, PXRD data provided that the ligand and its complexes have nature that is crystalline. Antimicrobial activity was tested for their effectiveness against various Gram-positive and negative bacteria and anti-fungal efficacy, in addition to the efficiency of their cytotoxicity against cancer cell lines such as (Hep-G2 and MCF-7) to assess their potential as chemotherapy agents where the IC 50 for Ln 3+ complexes in the range (0.095–0.242) and (0.110–0.298) µM against Hep-G2 and MCF-7 cancer cell lines, respectively and La(III) demonstrated a high degree of activity, similarly, in the case of antimicrobials, it showed the highest activity. The ability of these complexes to bind to the active sites of the Bacillus subtilis receptor (PDB ID: 6A4M) and methionine adenosyl-transferases in liver tumors (PDB ID: 5A19) and human breast cancer MCF-7 (PDB ID: 4zvm) was evaluated using molecular docking studies utilizing MOA2022 software. According to the following pattern, the binding strength increased as the binding energy decreased: CBZ˂[Dy(CBZ ) 2 (H 2 O)Cl] 2+ ˂[Ce(CBZ ) 2 (H 2 O)Cl] 2+ ˂ [Nd(CBZ ) 2 (H 2 O)Cl] 2+ ˂[La(CBZ ) 2 (H 2 O)Cl] 2+ , indicating that the highest binding affinity and possible biological activity were displayed by the La(III) complex.
data.title_cn: 镧系元素-卡马西平配合物：合成、光谱表征、DFT 见解、分子对接和生物学评估
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 这项工作重点是合成四种新型稀土配合物：La (III)、Ce (III)、Nd (III) 和 Dy (III) 与卡马西平 (CBZ)。通过各种分析和光谱技术完成了合成配合物的几何结构和键合模式，数据表明新型配合物具有1:2（Ln 3+ :CBZ）电解质，通式为[Ln(CBZ) 2 (H 2 O)Cl]Cl 2 .H 2 O，Ln的分子量为：753.83、791.07、777.19和777.43。分别有3+复合物。光谱研究表明CBZ作为双齿配体通过其酰胺基团中的氮和氧原子相互作用，并通过密度函数理论证实了其几何八面体结构。另一方面，PXRD数据表明配体及其配合物具有结晶性质。除了对癌细胞系（Hep-G2 和 MCF-7）的细胞毒性效率外，还测试了其对各种革兰氏阳性和阴性细菌的抗菌活性和抗真菌功效，以评估其作为化疗药物的潜力，其中 Ln 3+ 复合物对 Hep-G2 和 Hep-G2 的 IC 50 在 (0.095–0.242) 和 (0.110–0.298) µM 范围内。 MCF-7 癌细胞系和 La(III) 分别表现出高度的活性，同样，在抗菌剂的情况下，它表现出最高的活性。利用 MOA2022 软件进行分子对接研究，评估了这些复合物与肝肿瘤 (PDB ID: 5A19) 和人乳腺癌 MCF-7 (PDB ID: 4zvm) 中枯草芽孢杆菌受体 (PDB ID: 6A4M) 和蛋氨酸腺苷转移酶活性位点结合的能力。根据以下规律，随着结合能的降低，结合强度增加： CBZ˂[Dy(CBZ ) 2 (H 2 O)Cl] 2+ ˂[Ce(CBZ ) 2 (H 2 O)Cl] 2+ ˂ [Nd(CBZ ) 2 (H 2 O)Cl] 2+ ˂[La(CBZ ) 2 (H 2 O)Cl] 2+ ，表明La(III) 配合物显示出最高的结合亲和力和可能的生物活性。

data.title: Drone-based composite risk mapping reveals vegetation–shade interaction and housing typology as key determinants of Aedes habitat risk
data.author: Zulfadli Mahfodz, Agus Naba, Pradeep Isawasan, Mohd Azuraidi Osman, Nazri Che Dom
data.summary: Persistent dengue transmission in tropical cities reflects a complex interplay between environmental microclimates and urban housing structure that supports Aedes mosquito breeding. This study applies drone-based microhabitat risk mapping integrated with a biologically defined Composite Risk Index (CRI) to quantify fine-scale environmental drivers of Aedes habitat risk across distinct residential typologies in Sect. 24, Shah Alam, Malaysia. High-resolution RGB imagery obtained using a DJI Phantom 4 Pro was processed to derive the Brightness Index (BI) as a proxy for shade intensity and the Excess Green Index (ExG) as an indicator of vegetation density. These indices were integrated a priori into a CRI to operationalise known ecological conditions favourable for Aedes. Spatial analysis revealed a consistent risk gradient, with terrace housing exhibiting higher Composite Risk Index (CRI) values than flat complexes (low-density terrace (Teres D) > dense terrace (Teres B) > medium-rise (Flat H) > high-rise (Flat B)), demonstrating that housing typology modulates the spatial expression of microhabitat risk rather than vegetation presence alone. Model calibration showed high predictive agreement (R² = 0.91), with the top 20% of CRI-ranked pixels capturing 65% of observed breeding-prone zones, indicating strong spatial discriminative performance. These findings highlight that vegetation–shade coupling, expressed through housing morphology, governs Aedes habitat persistence and that drone-based microclimate mapping provides a precision surveillance tool for spatially targeted dengue control.
data.title_cn: 基于无人机的综合风险测绘揭示了植被-遮荫相互作用和住房类型是伊蚊栖息地风险的关键决定因素
data.abstract_cn: 热带城市持续存在的登革热传播反映出环境小气候与支持伊蚊繁殖的城市住房结构之间复杂的相互作用。本研究应用基于无人机的微生境风险测绘与生物学定义的综合风险指数（CRI）相结合，以量化伊蚊栖息地风险在不同居住类型中的精细环境驱动因素。 24、马来西亚莎阿南。使用 DJI Phantom 4 Pro 获得的高分辨率 RGB 图像经过处理，得出作为阴影强度代理的亮度指数 (BI) 和作为植被密度指标的过量绿色指数 (ExG)。这些指数被预先整合到 CRI 中，以实施已知的有利于伊蚊的生态条件。空间分析显示出一致的风险梯度，联排住宅表现出比扁平综合体更高的综合风险指数（CRI）值（低密度联排（Teres D）>密集联排（Teres B）>中层（H 公寓）>高层（B 公寓）），表明住房类型调节微生境风险的空间表达，而不是单独调节植被的存在。模型校准显示出高度的预测一致性（R² = 0.91），CRI 排名前 20% 的像素捕获了 65% 观察到的繁殖易发区域，表明具有很强的空间辨别性能。这些发现强调，通过外壳形态表达的植被-遮荫耦合控制着伊蚊栖息地的持久性，而基于无人机的微气候测绘为空间目标登革热控制提供了精确的监测工具。

data.title: Geological controls on reservoir seismic responses
data.author: Mohammed Farfour, Hezam Al-Awah, Mohamed S. H. Moustafa, Mohamed A.K. El-Ghali
data.summary: This study investigates the geological controls on the seismic responses of gas-saturated sandstone reservoirs in offshore Australia. The targeted reservoirs belong to the Middle Jurassic Plover Formation, which comprises interbedded sandstone, mudstone, and coal deposited in a fluvial–deltaic environment. These reservoirs display significant and poorly understood variations in seismic amplitude responses, observed on stack sections both between proximal wells and across different reservoir intervals. Such inconsistencies introduce high uncertainty in lithology and fluid prediction. Amplitude Variation with Offset (AVO) analysis conducted on both synthetic and real seismic gathers reveals distinct AVO classes (I to IV) within the reservoirs. Rock physics analysis, supported by petrographic evidence and seismic inversion, demonstrates that these seismic expressions are primarily controlled by three key geological factors: (1) Variable lithology and thickness, particularly the occurrence of volcanic and siltstone interbeds acting as seals above certain reservoirs, which can shift the amplitude response from hard to soft; (2) Diagenetic alteration, including quartz cementation and chemical compaction, which stiffen the rock framework and modify AVO behavior; and (3) Depositional texture and grain-contact types, which vary laterally due to compartmentalizing faults. This study establishes a comprehensive interpretation framework where amplitude behavior serves as a diagnostic indicator of reservoir quality and connectivity. The proposed workflow and findings provide a valuable analog for de-risking amplitude-supported hydrocarbon prospects in similar fluvial–deltaic systems affected by diagenetic overprinting and structural complexity.
data.title_cn: 水库地震反应的地质控制
data.abstract_cn: 本研究调查了澳大利亚近海含气砂岩储层地震响应的地质控制。目标储层属于中侏罗统鸻组，由河流三角洲环境中沉积的砂岩、泥岩和煤互层组成。这些储层在地震振幅响应方面表现出显着且人们知之甚少的变化，这是在近井之间和不同储层层段的叠加剖面上观察到的。这种不一致给岩性和流体预测带来了高度的不确定性。对合成地震道集和真实地震道集进行的振幅随偏移距变化 (AVO) 分析揭示了储层内不同的 AVO 类别（I 至 IV）。岩相证据和地震反演支持的岩石物理分析表明，这些地震表达式主要受三个关键地质因素控制：（1）岩性和厚度变化，特别是某些储层上方充当密封作用的火山和粉砂岩互层的出现，可以将振幅响应从硬转变为软； (2) 成岩蚀变，包括石英胶结作用和化学压实作用，使岩石骨架变硬并改变 AVO 行为； (3)沉积结构和颗粒接触类型，由于分区断层而横向变化。本研究建立了一个综合解释框架，其中振幅行为可作为储层质量和连通性的诊断指标。所提出的工作流程和研究结果为降低受成岩叠印和结构复杂性影响的类似河流-三角洲系统中振幅支持的碳氢化合物前景的风险提供了有价值的模拟。

data.title: KLHDC4 serves as a novel prognostic biomarker and drives tumor progression via PI3K/AKT signaling in clear cell renal cell carcinoma
data.author: Qingjiang Xu, Weili Chen, Senming Cao, Xiubin Li, Xiang Wu, Xin Ma
data.summary: The clinical significance and molecular mechanisms of KLHDC4 in malignancies, particularly in clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC), remain poorly understood. In this study, we integrated multi-omics data—including transcriptomic, proteomic, and single-cell RNA sequencing—to systematically evaluate the clinical relevance and functional role of KLHDC4, followed by experimental validation. Our results demonstrated that KLHDC4 is significantly upregulated in multiple cancer types and serves as an independent prognostic biomarker for poor survival in ccRCC. KLHDC4 expression was correlated with immune cell infiltration, tumor mutational profiles, and immune checkpoint expression. Furthermore, KLHDC4 levels predicted response to drug therapies, including immunotherapy and tyrosine kinase inhibitors. Functional experiments showed that KLHDC4 knockdown suppressed proliferation, migration, and invasion in vitro, as well as tumor growth in vivo, whereas its overexpression promoted malignant phenotypes. Mechanistic investigations through RNA sequencing and Western blot analysis indicated that KLHDC4 activates the PI3K/AKT signaling pathway. Rescue assays confirmed that KLHDC4-driven oncogenic effects are partially mediated through this axis. Additionally, molecular docking identified ledipasvir as a potential KLHDC4 inhibitor. Collectively, our findings establish KLHDC4 as a novel prognostic biomarker and therapeutic predictor, highlighting the KLHDC4/PI3K/AKT axis as a potential target for ccRCC treatment.
data.title_cn: KLHDC4 作为一种新型预后生物标志物，在透明细胞肾细胞癌中通过 PI3K/AKT 信号传导驱动肿瘤进展
data.abstract_cn: KLHDC4 在恶性肿瘤（尤其是透明细胞肾细胞癌 (ccRCC)）中的临床意义和分子机制仍知之甚少。在这项研究中，我们整合了多组学数据（包括转录组、蛋白质组和单细胞 RNA 测序），系统地评估 KLHDC4 的临床相关性和功能作用，然后进行实验验证。我们的结果表明，KLHDC4 在多种癌症类型中显着上调，并可作为 ccRCC 生存不良的独立预后生物标志物。 KLHDC4 表达与免疫细胞浸润、肿瘤突变谱和免疫检查点表达相关。此外，KLHDC4 水平预测对药物治疗的反应，包括免疫治疗和酪氨酸激酶抑制剂。功能实验表明，KLHDC4 敲低可抑制体外增殖、迁移和侵袭，以及体内肿瘤生长，而其过表达则会促进恶性表型。通过 RNA 测序和蛋白质印迹分析进行的机制研究表明 KLHDC4 激活 PI3K/AKT 信号通路。拯救试验证实，KLHDC4 驱动的致癌作用部分是通过该轴介导的。此外，分子对接还确定 ledipasvir 是一种潜在的 KLHDC4 抑制剂。总的来说，我们的研究结果将 KLHDC4 确立为一种新型预后生物标志物和治疗预测因子，强调 KLHDC4/PI3K/AKT 轴作为 ccRCC 治疗的潜在靶点。

data.title: Comparison of 3D ankle kinematics between minimal inertial measurement units configuration and optical motion capture system under diverse walking conditions
data.author: Jongsu Kim, Lingchao Xie, Sanghyun Cho
data.summary: Abstract Accurate assessment of three-dimensional ankle kinematics is essential for advancing biomechanical analyses and informing potential clinical applications. While optical motion capture systems (OMCs) are considered the gold standard, their high cost and limited portability restrict their use outside the laboratory. Inertial measurement units (IMUs) offer a more practical alternative; however, concerns remain regarding their validity and reliability in diverse walking conditions. This study evaluated the agreement and repeatability of IMU-derived ankle kinematics relative to OMCs across three walking surfaces: level ground, inward wedge, and outward wedge. Ankle movements in the sagittal, frontal, and transverse planes were analyzed using a minimal sensor configuration. Moderate to high agreement and consistent repeatability were observed in the sagittal and transverse planes, particularly during level and inward wedge floor walking. Conversely, the frontal plane demonstrated limited agreement under wedged conditions, likely because of complex multisegmental foot dynamics and reference frame misalignment from static calibration. Despite these limitations, consistent repeatability across conditions supports the use of IMUs for tracking ankle kinematics outside the laboratory. These findings suggest the preliminary applicability of IMUs as a functional tool for interpreting ankle kinematics outside the laboratory.
data.title_cn: 不同步行条件下最小惯性测量单元配置与光学运动捕捉系统之间的 3D 踝关节运动学比较
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 三维踝关节运动学的准确评估对于推进生物力学分析和为潜在的临床应用提供信息至关重要。虽然光学动作捕捉系统 (OMC) 被认为是黄金标准，但其高成本和有限的便携性限制了其在实验室之外的使用。惯性测量单元 (IMU) 提供了更实用的替代方案；然而，人们仍然担心它们在不同步行条件下的有效性和可靠性。本研究评估了 IMU 衍生的踝关节运动学相对于 OMC 在三种行走表面（水平地面、向内楔形和向外楔形）上的一致性和可重复性。使用最小的传感器配置分析了矢状面、额状面和横向面的踝关节运动。在矢状面和横向面上观察到中等到高度的一致性和一致的重复性，特别是在水平和向内楔形地板行走期间。相反，额平面在楔入条件下表现出有限的一致性，这可能是由于复杂的多段脚动力学和静态校准的参考系未对准。尽管存在这些限制，但不同条件下一致的重复性支持在实验室外使用 IMU 跟踪踝关节运动学。这些发现表明 IMU 作为一种在实验室外解释踝关节运动学的功能工具的初步适用性。

data.title: Optimization of laser, irrigation and suction settings for automated ureteroscopic lithotripsy in impacted stones ex vivo study part II
data.author: Hyomyoung Lee, Jose Carlo R. Elises, Dong Hyun Kang, Paul R. Villegas, Dyandra Parikesit, Ching-Heung Yen, Mohammed Almujhim, Nasser Aljameel, Fahad Alzahrani, Omar Sulaiman, Sung Yong Cho
data.summary: This study aims to optimize laser, irrigation, and suction settings for automated laser lithotripsy in impacted ureteral stones by analyzing intra-ureteral temperature (IUT) and pressure (IUP). A novel Laser: Stop ratio (LS ratio) was introduced to balance laser activation and resting times. An ex-vivo porcine kidney was used to evaluate the settings [Thulium fiber laser (TFL) and Holmium: Yttrium-aluminum-garnet (Ho: YAG) at 1.0 J/10Hz, 0.5 J/20Hz], pump-based irrigation of 30mmHg (P30) and 50 mmHg (P50), LS ratios (2s:2s, 2s:4s, 2s:6s) and the use of a flexible and navigable suction ureteral access sheath (FANS-UAS). With FANS-UAS, a Laser: Active suction: Rest ratio of 2s:2s:2s was applied at 200mmHg suction. IUT and IUP were recorded every 30 s for 5 min with dangerous thresholds at > 50 °C for over 1 min or > 56 °C at any time. Under P30 with an LS ratio of 2s:6s, pop-dusting was observed to be limited, with 15 and 30 s for TFL and Ho: YAG, respectively. At 0.5 J/20Hz, the pop-dusting was extended to 3 and 5 min, respectively. Under P50, continuous pop-dusting was achievable across all settings when an LS ratio of 2s:2s, 2s:4s, and 2s:6s were employed. The FANS-UAS enabled continuous pop-dusting under P30 at 0.5 J/20Hz, although it was restricted at 1.0 J/10Hz. Under P50, continuous pop-dusting was achievable across all settings, with the lowest recorded IUT. The IUP remained within safety thresholds under both P30 and P50. When defined with fixed activation and rest times, the LS ratio may serve as a practical reference for balancing safety and efficiency in automated laser lithotripsy.
data.title_cn: 离体结石自动输尿管镜碎石术激光、冲洗和抽吸设置的优化研究第二部分
data.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在通过分析输尿管内温度 (IUT) 和压力 (IUP)，优化受影响输尿管结石自动激光碎石术的激光、冲洗和抽吸设置。引入了一种新颖的激光：停止比（LS 比）来平衡激光激活和休息时间。使用离体猪肾来评估设置[铥光纤激光器 (TFL) 和钬：钇铝石榴石 (Ho: YAG)，1.0 J/10Hz、0.5 J/20Hz]、30mmHg (P30) 和 50 mmHg (P50) 的泵式冲洗、LS 比率（2s:2s、2s:4s、 2s:6s) 以及使用灵活且可导航的抽吸输尿管通路鞘 (FANS-UAS)。对于 FANS-UAS，在 200mmHg 吸力下应用激光：主动吸力：休息比为 2 秒：2 秒：2 秒。每 30 秒记录一次 IUT 和 IUP，持续 5 分钟，危险阈值在 > 50 °C 持续超过 1 分钟或任何时间 > 56 °C。在 LS 比率为 2s:6s 的 P30 下，观察到喷尘是有限的，TFL 和 Ho:YAG 分别为 15 秒和 30 秒。在 0.5 J/20Hz 下，喷粉时间分别延长至 3 和 5 分钟。在 P50 下，当采用 2s:2s、2s:4s 和 2s:6s 的 LS 比率时，在所有设置下都可以实现连续喷粉。 FANS-UAS 能够在 P30 下以 0.5 J/20Hz 进行连续喷粉，尽管其限制在 1.0 J/10Hz。在 P50 下，在所有设置下均可实现连续喷粉，且 IUT 记录最低。 IUP 仍处于 P30 和 P50 的安全阈值内。当定义固定的激活和休息时间时，LS 比率可以作为平衡自动激光碎石术的安全性和效率的实用参考。

data.title: Computational assessment of flow dynamics and turbulence generation in hydrofoil-crested weirs
data.author: Amir Ghaderi, Amir Hossein Rezaei, Amir Hossein Mohammadnezhadaghdam, Hossein Mohammadnezhad
data.summary: Hydrofoil-crested weirs (HFWs) are increasingly applied in hydraulic systems due to their ability to regulate flow and dissipate energy efficiently, yet their hydrodynamic behavior remains strongly dependent on crest geometry. However, the influence of hydrofoil thickness on critical hydraulic parameters like flow velocity, pressure, and turbulence has not been comprehensively quantified. This study presents a numerical investigation of flow over HFWs with different hydrofoil thickness ratios, focusing on the distributions of velocity, pressure, and turbulence-related parameters under various discharges. Simulations were performed using a Reynolds-averaged Navier–Stokes (RANS) framework, employing a high-fidelity CFD approach with turbulence models to capture key hydraulic characteristics. Results were analyzed at multiple downstream stations to assess the influence of geometry on flow structures, with particular attention to the quantitative effects of hydrofoil thickness on flow dynamics. The findings quantitatively demonstrate that hydrofoil thickness substantially affects near-crest velocity and turbulence fields. Thicker profiles resulted in up to a 20% increase in near-surface jet velocity and produced 30–40% higher turbulent kinetic energy compared to thinner profiles. Thicker profiles promote earlier acceleration of the surface jet and produce wider high-velocity zones in the upper water column, while maximum velocities further downstream converge across geometries. Pressure analysis revealed that thicker crests generate stronger local loadings and sharper reductions in pressure immediately downstream of the crest, with inter-geometry differences up to ~ 15% under identical flow conditions. However, pressure distributions stabilize toward near-hydrostatic profiles at distances beyond ~ 0.3–0.5 m downstream. However, pressure distributions stabilize toward hydrostatic profiles at greater distances. Turbulence characteristics exhibited the strongest dependence on hydrofoil geometry, with thicker profiles (N36) producing significantly higher turbulent kinetic energy (TKE), turbulence intensity (TI), and dissipation rates (TD), particularly in the surface and mid-depth regions. Compared with thinner profiles, these enhancements promote stronger vertical mixing and energy dissipation, with differences reaching up to ~ 35%. Overall, the results highlight a trade-off between stability and dissipation efficiency: thinner crests provide smoother velocity and pressure fields, whereas thicker crests enhance turbulence-driven energy dissipation. These insights support the selection and optimization of HFW designs for diverse hydraulic applications.
data.title_cn: 水翼顶堰中流动动力学和湍流产生的计算评估
data.abstract_cn: 水翼堰（HFW）由于能够有效调节流量和消散能量而越来越多地应用于液压系统，但它们的流体动力学行为仍然强烈依赖于堰顶的几何形状。然而，水翼厚度对流速、压力和湍流等关键水力参数的影响尚未得到全面量化。本研究对不同水翼厚度比的 HFW 上的流动进行了数值研究，重点关注不同流量下速度、压力和湍流相关参数的分布。使用雷诺平均纳维斯托克斯 (RANS) 框架进行模拟，采用高保真 CFD 方法和湍流模型来捕获关键的水力特性。对多个下游站的结果进行了分析，以评估几何形状对流动结构的影响，特别关注水翼厚度对流动动力学的定量影响。研究结果定量地表明，水翼厚度显着影响近波峰速度和湍流场。与较薄的剖面相比，较厚的剖面可使近表面射流速度增加 20%，并产生较高 30-40% 的湍流动能。较厚的轮廓促进表面射流的早期加速，并在上部水柱中产生更宽的高速区域，而下游的最大速度在几何形状上汇聚。压力分析表明，较厚的波峰会产生更强的局部载荷，并且紧邻波峰下游的压力会急剧下降，在相同的流动条件下，几何形状之间的差异高达约 15%。然而，在下游约 0.3-0.5 m 的距离处，压力分布稳定为接近静水压力分布。然而，压力分布在更远的距离处趋于静压分布。湍流特性表现出对水翼几何形状的最强依赖性，较厚的轮廓（N36）产生显着更高的湍流动能（TKE）、湍流强度（TI）和耗散率（TD），特别是在表面和中深度区域。与更薄的型材相比，这些增强功能可促进更强的垂直混合和能量耗散，差异高达约 35%。总体而言，结果强调了稳定性和耗散效率之间的权衡：较薄的波峰提供更平滑的速度和压力场，而较厚的波峰增强湍流驱动的能量耗散。这些见解支持针对不同液压应用选择和优化 HFW 设计。

data.title: Optimized paraquat removal using Bi₄O₅Br₂: synthesis, performance evaluation, and mechanistic insights
data.author: Zahra Dehghani, Majid Fekri, Majid Mahmoodabadi, Mahboub Saffari, Mohammad Hady Farpoor
data.summary: Paraquat (PQ), a widely used bipyridinium herbicide, poses severe environmental and public health risks due to its high toxicity and persistence in aquatic systems. In this study, a Bi₄O₅Br₂ composite was synthesized via a double-solvent-derived route using CAU-17 as a precursor, and subsequently employed as an efficient adsorbent for PQ removal from water. Comprehensive characterization using XRD, FTIR, BET, FE-SEM, and EDX revealed a well-defined lamellar mesoporous structure (specific surface area: 63.12 m²/g, average pore size: ~7 nm) and a homogeneous elemental distribution, offering abundant and accessible active sites for adsorption. The adsorption performance was systematically optimized through response surface methodology (RSM) based on a Box–Behnken design (BBD), considering adsorbent dosage, pH, contact time, and initial PQ concentration as key parameters. The model showed excellent fitting and predictive accuracy, and the results highlighted that adsorbent dosage and solution pH were the most influential factors governing removal efficiency, whereas contact time exhibited a moderate effect and PQ concentration played a comparatively minor role. Under the optimal conditions (adsorbent dosage of 0.0187 g, pH 6.47, contact time 38.26 min, and initial PQ concentration 3.89 mg L⁻¹), a maximum removal efficiency of 97.47% was achieved. Mechanistic investigation revealed that PQ removal occurred predominantly through electrostatic interactions between the negatively charged Bi₄O₅Br₂ surface (under near-neutral to alkaline conditions) and cationic PQ²⁺ molecules, supplemented by physical adsorption and hydrogen bonding. FTIR analysis before and after adsorption confirmed the participation of surface hydroxyl groups through slight shifts and intensity reductions in the O–H stretching band, suggesting their involvement in electrostatic binding and hydrogen bonding. The mesoporous architecture of Bi₄O₅Br₂ facilitated rapid intraparticle diffusion, enabling fast attainment of equilibrium. Compared with previously reported adsorbents, Bi₄O₅Br₂ demonstrated superior performance at an ultralow dosage, highlighting its cost-effectiveness and scalability for practical water treatment. Overall, these findings establish Bi₄O₅Br₂ as a promising candidate for the remediation of herbicide-contaminated water. Future work should focus on regeneration performance, stability under repeated use, and validation using real wastewater matrices.
data.title_cn: 使用 Bi₄O₅Br2 优化百草枯去除：合成、性能评估和机理见解
data.abstract_cn: 百草枯 (PQ) 是一种广泛使用的联吡啶鎓类除草剂，由于其高毒性和在水生系统中的持久性，造成严重的环境和公共健康风险。在这项研究中，使用 CAU-17 作为前体，通过双溶剂衍生路线合成了 Bi4O5Br2 复合材料，随后用作从水中去除 PQ 的有效吸附剂。使用 XRD、FTIR、BET、FE-SEM 和 EDX 进行的综合表征揭示了明确的层状介孔结构（比表面积：63.12 m²/g，平均孔径：~7 nm）和均匀的元素分布，提供丰富且易于吸附的活性位点。吸附性能通过基于 Box-Behnken 设计 (BBD) 的响应面法 (RSM) 进行系统优化，考虑吸附剂剂量、pH、接触时间和初始 PQ 浓度作为关键参数。该模型显示出出色的拟合和预测准确性，结果表明，吸附剂用量和溶液 pH 值是影响去除效率的最大因素，而接触时间的影响适中，PQ 浓度的作用相对较小。在最佳条件下（吸附剂用量0.0187 g，pH 6.47，接触时间38.26 min，PQ初始浓度3.89 mg·L-1），最大去除效率达到97.47%。机理研究表明，PQ 的去除主要是通过带负电的 Bi4O5Br2 表面（在接近中性至碱性条件下）和阳离子 PQ2+ 分子之间的静电相互作用发生的，并辅以物理吸附和氢键作用。吸附前后的 FTIR 分析通过 O-H 伸缩带的轻微变化和强度降低证实了表面羟基的参与，表明它们参与了静电结合和氢键。 Bi4O5Br2 的介孔结构有利于快速颗粒内扩散，从而能够快速达到平衡。与之前报道的吸附剂相比，Bi4O5Br2 在超低剂量下表现出优异的性能，突出了其实际水处理的成本效益和可扩展性。总体而言，这些发现表明 Bi₄O₅Br2 是修复除草剂污染水体的有希望的候选材料。未来的工作应侧重于再生性能、重复使用下的稳定性以及使用真实废水基质的验证。

data.title: Optimizing just-in-time adaptive interventions for interpersonal distress: mechanisms, prediction, and the challenge of engagement
data.author: Agata Jaremba, Sarah O’Reilly, Liam Mason, Tobias Nolte, Madiha Shaikh, Ciarán O’Driscoll
data.summary: Common mental health disorders (CMD) feature fluctuating emotional and interpersonal symptoms inadequately addressed by traditional weekly therapies. Ecological momentary interventions offer potential for timely support, yet their mechanisms and optimal delivery contexts remain unclear. This secondary analysis of a randomized trial (N = 77) compared mindfulness and mentalization micro-interventions triggered by personalized symptom thresholds. We examined dynamic symptom networks, proximal effectiveness, engagement predictors, and distress forecasting in adults with CMD. Dynamic networks revealed stable communities (interpersonal threat, social connection, affective states) with mood as a key bridge. No significant proximal intervention effects were observed. Non-engagement was significantly predicted by high stress (OR = 1.21), elevated mood (OR = 1.22), and perceived criticism (OR = 1.22). Conversely, cumulative symptom triggers (OR = 0.69) and social contact (OR = 0.83) facilitated engagement. The dynamic prediction model achieved fair performance (AUC = 0.66) for next-beep distress. Beyond autoregressive effects, perceived criticism (OR: 1.12) and paradoxically perceived support predicted future distress (OR = 1.14), while warmth was protective (OR = 0.87). Micro-interventions operate through stable networks and may yield cumulative rather than immediate benefits. High stress and criticism impede intervention use despite high need highlighting the necessity for context-sensitive, low-friction adaptive designs to align clinical need with receptivity.
data.title_cn: 优化针对人际困扰的及时适应性干预措施：机制、预测和参与的挑战
data.abstract_cn: 常见的精神健康障碍（CMD）的特点是情绪波动和人际关系症状，传统的每周治疗无法充分解决。生态瞬时干预提供了及时支持的潜力，但其机制和最佳实施环境仍不清楚。这是一项随机试验 (N = 77) 的二次分析，比较了个性化症状阈值触发的正念和心理化微观干预措施。我们研究了成人 CMD 的动态症状网络、近端有效性、参与预测因子和痛苦预测。动态网络揭示了稳定的社区（人际威胁、社会联系、情感状态），而情绪是关键的桥梁。没有观察到显着的近端干预效应。高压力 (OR = 1.21)、情绪高涨 (OR = 1.22) 和感知批评 (OR = 1.22) 显着预测不投入。相反，累积症状触发因素（OR = 0.69）和社交接触（OR = 0.83）促进参与。动态预测模型在下一次嘟嘟声遇险方面取得了不错的性能（AUC = 0.66）。除了自回归效应之外，感知的批评（OR：1.12）和矛盾的感知支持预测未来的痛苦（OR = 1.14），而温暖则具有保护作用（OR = 0.87）。微观干预通过稳定的网络运作，可能会产生累积效益，而不是立竿见影的效益。尽管高需求强调了上下文敏感、低摩擦适应性设计的必要性，以使临床需求与接受性保持一致，但高压力和批评阻碍了干预的使用。

data.title: Automated cone photoreceptor detection using synthetic data and deep learning in confocal adaptive optics scanning laser ophthalmoscope images
data.author: Mital Shah, Laura K. Young, Susan M. Downes, Hannah E. Smithson, Ana I. L. Namburete
data.summary: Abstract Adaptive optics scanning laser ophthalmoscope (AOSLO) imaging enables the cone photoreceptor mosaic to be visualised in the living human eye. Performing quantitative analysis of these images requires identification of individual photoreceptors. This is typically performed by manual labelling, which is subjective, time consuming and not feasible on a large scale. Automated algorithms to replace manual labelling are required and deep learning-based methods provide an effective way of achieving this. However, this approach requires large volumes of annotated training data that are difficult to acquire. Synthetic data may help to bridge this lack of annotated training data. A U-Net configuration was trained using a large synthetic dataset of confocal AOSLO images generated using ERICA alongside a smaller dataset of real confocal AOSLO images (Milwaukee dataset). Model performance was assessed by calculating the Dice coefficient, a metric quantifying segmentation overlap, on both a real held-out test set and an independent real dataset (Oxford dataset). Results from this evaluation were benchmarked against expert labelling and two automated cone detection methods: a confocal convolutional neural network (CNN) (1), and a combined graph-theory and dynamic programming approach (2)). The mean Dice coefficient compared to manual labelling was 0.989 (U-Net), 0.989 (confocal CNN), and 0.985 (graph-theory and dynamic programming) on the held-out test set. On the independent Oxford dataset, the U-Net achieved a mean Dice coefficient of 0.962 compared to manual labelling. Results show performance that is comparable to the gold standard of manual labelling and two automated cone detection methods. Furthermore, we demonstrate generalisability of this approach on an independent real dataset with images from higher retinal eccentricities. This approach may be useful for quantitative analysis of the photoreceptor mosaic in patients with retinal disease to provide cell-specific imaging biomarkers from AOSLO images.
data.title_cn: 在共焦自适应光学扫描激光检眼镜图像中使用合成数据和深度学习进行自动锥体光感受器检测
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 自适应光学扫描激光检眼镜 (AOSLO) 成像使锥体光感受器马赛克能够在活体人眼中可视化。对这些图像进行定量分析需要识别各个光感受器。这通常通过手动标记来执行，这是主观的、耗时的并且不适合大规模实施。需要用自动化算法来代替手动标记，而基于深度学习的方法提供了实现这一目标的有效方法。然而，这种方法需要大量难以获取的带注释的训练数据。合成数据可能有助于弥补带注释的训练数据的缺乏。使用 ERICA 生成的共焦 AOSLO 图像的大型合成数据集以及真实共焦 AOSLO 图像的较小数据集（密尔沃基数据集）来训练 U-Net 配置。通过在真实的测试集和独立的真实数据集（牛津数据集）上计算 Dice 系数（一种量化分割重叠的指标）来评估模型性能。该评估的结果以专家标记和两种自动视锥细胞检测方法为基准：共焦卷积神经网络 (CNN) (1) 以及组合图论和动态规划方法 (2))。在保留测试集上，与手动标记相比，平均 Dice 系数为 0.989（U-Net）、0.989（共焦 CNN）和 0.985（图论和动态规划）。在独立的牛津数据集上，与手动标记相比，U-Net 的平均 Dice 系数为 0.962。结果显示，其性能可与手动标记的黄金标准和两种自动锥体检测方法相媲美。此外，我们在具有较高视网膜偏心率的图像的独立真实数据集上证明了这种方法的普遍性。这种方法可能有助于对视网膜疾病患者的光感受器镶嵌进行定量分析，以从 AOSLO 图像中提供细胞特异性成像生物标志物。

data.title: Kinetic, equilibrium, and thermodynamic study of Methylene Blue adsorption on orange peel biochar prepared by microwave-assisted pyrolysis
data.author: Jhonny Correa-Abril, Elvia V. Cabrera, Nilo Robles, J. L. López Terán, Ullrich Stahl
data.summary: This study presents a sustainable approach for Methylene Blue (MB) dye removal using pristine, non-activated biochar derived from orange peel waste via Microwave-Assisted Pyrolysis (MAP). The key novelty lies in the systematic comparison of the biochar’s adsorption performance under both pH-controlled (constant pH 4) and unregulated pH conditions, demonstrating that pH regulation is essential for optimizing adsorption efficiency. The resulting biochar exhibited a high fixed carbon content (60.89%), an alkaline surface (Point of zero charge (pHpzc) = 11.20, ZPotential = 0.1 mV @ pH 9), and oxygenated functional groups. Best MB removal of 83% was achieved at pH 4, despite the expected electrostatic repulsion. Kinetic studies showed the best fit with the Elovich model, indicating a heterogeneous surface. The Langmuir isotherm accurately described the equilibrium data, revealing a maximum adsorption capacity (qmax) of 20.57 mg g⁻1 under pH-controlled conditions, representing an 83% increase over the 11.24 mg g⁻1 obtained in the unregulated scenario. Thermodynamic analysis confirmed the process is spontaneous (ΔG° < 0), endothermic (ΔH° = + 4.88 kJ mol⁻1 at constant pH), and governed by physisorption mechanisms, including hydrogen bonding and π-π interactions. This work demonstrates that pristine orange peel biochar generated via MAP is a highly effective adsorbent and highlights the critical impact of pH control on improving adsorption capacity and elucidating the dominant physisorption mechanisms.
data.title_cn: 微波辅助热解橙皮生物炭吸附亚甲基蓝的动力学、平衡和热力学研究
data.abstract_cn: 这项研究提出了一种可持续的方法，使用从橙皮废物中提取的原始、非活化生物炭，通过微波辅助热解 (MAP) 去除亚甲基蓝 (MB) 染料。关键的新颖之处在于系统比较了生物炭在 pH 控制（恒定 pH 4）和非调节 pH 条件下的吸附性能，表明 pH 调节对于优化吸附效率至关重要。所得生物炭具有高固定碳含量（60.89%）、碱性表面（零电荷点 (pHpzc) = 11.20，ZPotential = 0.1 mV @ pH 9）和含氧官能团。尽管存在预期的静电斥力，但在 pH 4 时仍实现了 83% 的最佳 MB 去除率。动力学研究表明最适合 Elovich 模型，表明表面不均匀。 Langmuir 等温线准确地描述了平衡数据，显示在 pH 控制条件下最大吸附容量 (qmax) 为 20.57 mg g-1，比​​未调节情况下获得的 11.24 mg g-1 增加了 83%。热力学分析证实该过程是自发的（ΔG° < 0）、吸热的（ΔH° = + 4.88 kJ mol⁻1 在恒定 pH 下），并受物理吸附机制控制，包括氢键和 π-π 相互作用。这项工作表明，通过 MAP 生成的原始橙皮生物炭是一种高效的吸附剂，并强调了 pH 控制对提高吸附能力和阐明主要物理吸附机制的关键影响。

data.title: Validation of chemoresistance phenotypes in pleural mesothelioma across 2D, 3D, and in vivo models
data.author: Huaikai Shi, Sakthi Priya Selvamani, Richard Zelei, Ling Zhuang, Dongwei Wang, Ben Johnson, Vivek Dharwal, Duo Xu, Yiwei Wang, Tristan Rutland, Sonja Klebe, Steven Kao, Anthony Linton, Elham Hosseini-Beheshti, Yuen Yee Cheng
data.summary: Pleural mesothelioma (PM) is a highly aggressive cancer with limited treatment efficacy and poor prognosis. Conventional two-dimensional (2D) culture models fail to replicate the tumour microenvironment (TME), limiting their translational relevance. Here, we establish a three-dimensional (3D) spheroid model to investigate chemotherapy resistance across different PM subtypes. Compared to 2D cultures, 3D spheroids display enhanced resistance to cisplatin-pemetrexed, with elevated IC₅₀ values, reduced apoptosis, and altered cell cycle profiles. Seahorse metabolic analysis of 3D spheroids demonstrate a suppressed metabolic phenotype, characterised by reduced oxidative phosphorylation (OCR). However, the glycolytic capacity was not upregulated, consistent with the hypoxic and nutrient-limited conditions observed in mesothelioma lesions. In parallel, molecular profiling identifies subtype-specific miRNA signatures that closely align with patient-derived datasets. Proteomic analysis of 3D cultures identifies upregulation of PI3K/AKT and Notch/VEGF signalling, implicating these pathways in treatment resistance. Histological assessment of xenografts further confirms 3D model fidelity in capturing tumour fibrosis, necrosis, and response to therapy. These findings position the 3D spheroid system as a robust and physiologically relevant platform for modelling drug resistance and guiding therapeutic development in PM.
data.title_cn: 跨 2D、3D 和体内模型验证胸膜间皮瘤的化疗耐药表型
data.abstract_cn: 胸膜间皮瘤（PM）是一种高度侵袭性的癌症，治疗效果有限且预后不良。传统的二维 (2D) 培养模型无法复制肿瘤微环境 (TME)，限制了其转化相关性。在这里，我们建立了三维 (3D) 球体模型来研究不同 PM 亚型的化疗耐药性。与 2D 培养物相比，3D 球体对顺铂-培美曲塞的耐药性增强，IC₅₀ 值升高、细胞凋亡减少并改变了细胞周期特征。 3D 球体的海马代谢分析表明代谢表型受到抑制，其特征是氧化磷酸化 (OCR) 减少。然而，糖酵解能力并未上调，这与间皮瘤病变中观察到的缺氧和营养有限的条件一致。与此同时，分子分析可识别与患者来源的数据集密切相关的亚型特异性 miRNA 特征。 3D 培养物的蛋白质组学分析确定了 PI3K/AKT 和 Notch/VEGF 信号传导的上调，表明这些通路与治疗耐药有关。异种移植物的组织学评估进一步证实了 3D 模型在捕获肿瘤纤维化、坏死和治疗反应方面的保真度。这些发现将 3D 球体系统定位为一个强大且生理相关的平台，用于建模耐药性并指导 PM 的治疗开发。

data.title: Systems-level transcriptomic analysis reveals synapse-related gene dysregulation in peripheral leukocytes of MDD patients
data.author: Anny Silva Adri, Adriel Leal Nóbile, Débora Gomes de Albuquerque, Pedro Marçal Barcelos, Fernando Yuri Nery do Vale, Roseane Galdioli Nava, Yohan Lucas G. Correa, Lena Friederick Schimke, Luiz Fernando Onuchic, Rodrigo Dalmolin, Rafael Machado Rezende, Haroldo Dutra Dias, Igor Salerno Filgueiras, Otavio Cabral-Marques
data.summary: Major depressive disorder (MDD) involves both central nervous system dysfunction and systemic immune alterations. Using a systems biology approach, we investigated whether peripheral leukocytes exhibit transcriptional changes in genes annotated to synaptic processes, molecular functions typically associated with neurons but also possibly implicated in immune cell biology. A meta-analysis of transcriptomic data from 3072 individuals identified 1383 meta-differentially expressed genes (metaDEGs) in leukocytes, including 73 whose known functions are linked to synaptic biology. Among them, functional enrichment analysis indicated synapse-related metaDEGs (48 downregulated, 25 upregulated) involved in synaptic vesicle cycling, neurotransmitter signaling, synaptic assembly, and neurogenesis. Linear discriminant analysis (LDA) identified 18 of these genes that robustly distinguished MDD patients from healthy controls across independent datasets. Notably, we identified metaDEGs shared between leukocytes and brain regions associated with MDD, indicating that genes traditionally linked to neuronal pathways are also expressed in immune cells, where they may contribute to immune-related mechanisms relevant to the disorder. These findings highlight potential systemic molecular patterns that warrant further investigation.
data.title_cn: 系统水平转录组分析揭示MDD患者外周白细胞中突触相关基因失调
data.abstract_cn: 重度抑郁症（MDD）涉及中枢神经系统功能障碍和全身免疫改变。使用系统生物学方法，我们研究了外周白细胞是否表现出与突触过程注释的基因转录变化，这些分子功能通常与神经元相关，但也可能与免疫细胞生物学有关。对 3072 名个体的转录组数据进行荟萃分析，鉴定出白细胞中的 1383 个元差异表达基因 (metaDEG)，其中 73 个已知功能与突触生物学相关。其中，功能富集分析表明突触相关的metDEG（48个下调，25个上调）参与突触小泡循环、神经递质信号传导、突触组装和神经发生。线性判别分析 (LDA) 确定了其中 18 个基因，可以在独立数据集中将 MDD 患者与健康对照区分开来。值得注意的是，我们发现了白细胞和与MDD相关的大脑区域之间共享的metaDEG，这表明传统上与神经元通路相关的基因也在免疫细胞中表达，它们可能有助于与该疾病相关的免疫相关机制。这些发现强调了值得进一步研究的潜在系统分子模式。

data.title: Autonomous path planning for intercostal robotic ultrasound imaging using reinforcement learning
data.author: Yuan Bi, Cheng Qian, Zhicheng Zhang, Nassir Navab, Zhongliang Jiang
data.summary: Abstract Ultrasound (US) is widely used in clinical practice for the screening internal organs and guiding interventions. Nonetheless, US imaging suffers from inter- and intra-operator variations. Leveraging the reproducibility offered by robots, robotic ultrasound systems emerge as a promising solution, offering enhanced precision, stability, and repeatability. To realize autonomous US scanning, robot learning algorithms have been widely explored. However, current approaches primarily base the decision-making process for US navigation on 2D US images data, often overlooking the integration of 3D anatomical knowledge, which is a critical component for path planning in anatomically complex regions, such as the intercostal area. To address this limitation, we propose a novel reinforcement learning (RL) approach for intercostal US scanning path planning, leveraging computed tomography (CT) templates and utilizing 3D state representations. To this end, a virtual environment is developed using CT templates with randomly initialized tumors of various shapes and locations as a training environment. In addition, task-specific state representation and reward functions are introduced to encourage the convergence of the training process while minimizing the effects of acoustic attenuation and shadows during scanning. It is important to note that the scope of this work is limited to the autonomous path planning component, while robotic execution and control integration will be addressed in future studies. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, experiments have been carried out on unseen patient models with randomly defined single or multiple scanning targets. The results demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed RL framework in planning non-shadowed US scanning trajectories in areas with limited acoustic access.
data.title_cn: 使用强化学习的肋间机器人超声成像自主路径规划
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 超声（US）广泛应用于临床实践中，用于筛查内脏器官和指导干预措施。尽管如此，超声成像仍存在操作者之间和操作者内部的差异。利用机器人提供的可重复性，机器人超声系统成为一种有前途的解决方案，提供更高的精度、稳定性和可重复性。为了实现自主超声扫描，机器人学习算法已被广泛探索。然而，当前的方法主要基于 2D US 图像数据进行 US 导航的决策过程，通常忽略了 3D 解剖知识的集成，而 3D 解剖知识是解剖复杂区域（例如肋间区域）路径规划的关键组成部分。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了一种新颖的强化学习 (RL) 方法，用于肋间超声扫描路径规划，利用计算机断层扫描 (CT) 模板并利用 3D 状态表示。为此，使用 CT 模板开发了一个虚拟环境，其中随机初始化了各种形状和位置的肿瘤作为训练环境。此外，还引入了特定于任务的状态表示和奖励函数，以鼓励训练过程的收敛，同时最大限度地减少扫描过程中声衰减和阴影的影响。值得注意的是，这项工作的范围仅限于自主路径规划组件，而机器人执行和控制集成将在未来的研究中解决。为了验证所提出方法的有效性，在具有随机定义的单个或多个扫描目标的看不见的患者模型上进行了实验。结果证明了所提出的 RL 框架在声学访问受限的区域中规划非阴影 US 扫描轨迹的效率。

data.title: Characterization of acoustic emission parameters and identification of staged fracture propagation in solidified body-coal combination based on experimental and machine learning approaches
data.author: Yi Tan, Hao Cheng, Manchao He, Wenbing Guo, Erhu Bai, Hui Li, Weiyu Guo, Yu Wang, Shaopu Zhang, Bingxing Chang, Shicheng Hu
data.summary: This study is aimed at exploring the instability failure mechanisms and precursory early-warning methods of the solidified body-coal (S-C) combination bearing structure. To achieve this aim, the dynamic response characteristics of multiple acoustic emission (AE) parameters from S-C combination specimens during loading were systematically analyzed through a combination of uniaxial compression experiments and AE monitoring. Furthermore, a crack propagation stage identification model was constructed based on machine learning. The following beneficial findings were yielded: The temporal evolution patterns of energy-frequency distribution indicators (Activity and b-value) and spectral characteristics (average frequency (AF) and risetime/amplitude (RA)), derived from AE time-frequency parameters, are highly correlated with the staged crack propagation behavior, and can be regarded as key precursors of instability in rock-coal combinations. Among the machine learning-based models constructed for identifying the staged fracture propagation states, light gradient boosting machine (LGB) performs the best overall, achieving a prediction accuracy of over 85% across all stages. Such a result verifies the strong characterization capability of fused AE parameter analysis for dynamic fracture evolution. The comprehensive early warning indicator CWI(t) was proposed, and its weight coefficients were optimized by SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) interpretability analysis, which markedly enhances the systematicity and robustness of instability risk assessment. These findings provide both a theoretical foundation and a data-driven method for the stability monitoring and early warning of the S-C combination bearing structure in continuous driving and gangue backfilling systems.
data.title_cn: 基于实验和机器学习方法的凝固体-煤组合中声发射参数的表征和分级裂缝扩展的识别
data.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在探讨凝固体-煤（S-C）组合承载结构的失稳破坏机制和预警方法。为了实现这一目标，通过单轴压缩实验和声发射监测相结合，系统分析了S-C组合试件在加载过程中多个声发射（AE）参数的动态响应特性。此外，基于机器学习构建了裂纹扩展阶段识别模型。得出了以下有益的发现：从AE时频参数导出的能频分布指标（活度和b值）和谱特征（平均频率（AF）和上升时间/幅度（RA））的时间演化模式与阶段性裂纹扩展行为高度相关，可以被视为岩煤组合不稳定的关键前兆。在为识别阶段性裂缝扩展状态而构建的基于机器学习的模型中，光梯度增强机（LGB）总体表现最好，在所有阶段实现了超过 85% 的预测精度。这一结果验证了融合AE参数分析对动态裂缝演化的强大表征能力。提出综合预警指标CWI(t)，并通过SHApley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）可解释性分析优化其权重系数，显着增强了不稳定风险评估的系统性和鲁棒性。这些研究结果为连续掘进和矸石充填系统中S-C组合承载结构的稳定性监测和预警提供了理论基础和数据驱动方法。

data.title: Real-time monitoring and closed-loop control system for multi-jet electrospinning with coaxial laser
data.author: Jiaxin Jiang, Zhengtao Sun, Junyu Chen, Huatan Chen, Gaofeng Zheng, Xiang Wang, Ruifang Ye, Wenwang Li
data.summary: The real-time monitoring and control of multi-jet electrospinning is significant to promote the quality of produced nanofiber membranes. In this paper, a multi-jet electrospinning system with coaxial laser was established to promote the jet visibility, which was beneficial for the accurate identification of jet features. A multi-jet feature recognition algorithm including the modules of image pre-processing, the jet feature segmentation and the jet feature identification was designed, and the processing time for the image processing to detect the multi-jet features of Taylor cone areas and visible jet lengths could be shortened to within 40ms. Then, the judgement rule of multi-jet ejection mode was designed and the multi-jet ejection mode was divided into four states according to the recognized jet feature parameters. Based on the identified multi-jet features, a closed-loop control system was designed with the applied voltage as the adjustment parameter. Through experimental verification, nanofiber membranes of good quality with uniform fiber diameter distribution were successfully obtained. This work has significant potential to promote the quality of produced nanofiber membranes and to accelerate the industrial applications of electrospinning technology.
data.title_cn: 同轴激光多喷头静电纺丝实时监控及闭环控制系统
data.abstract_cn: 多射流静电纺丝的实时监测和控制对于提高纳米纤维膜的质量具有重要意义。本文建立了一种采用同轴激光的多射流静电纺丝系统，以提高射流可见度，有利于射流特征的准确识别。设计了包括图像预处理、射流特征分割和射流特征识别模块的多射流特征识别算法，将图像处理检测泰勒锥区域和可见射流长度的多射流特征的处理时间缩短到40ms以内。然后设计了多射流喷射模式的判断规则，根据识别的射流特征参数将多射流喷射模式分为四种状态。根据确定的多射流特征，设计了以施加电压为调节参数的闭环控制系统。经过实验验证，成功获得了纤维直径分布均匀、质量良好的纳米纤维膜。这项工作对于提高纳米纤维膜的质量和加速静电纺丝技术的工业应用具有巨大的潜力。

data.title: Ablation of prostaglandin E2 signalling through dual receptor knockout in CAR T cells enhances therapeutic efficacy in solid tumours
data.author: Janina Dörr, Lisa Gregor, Sebastian B. Lacher, Arman Oner, Yi Sun, Ignazio Piseddu, Luisa Fertig, Sebastijan Spajic, Stefanie Lesch, Stefanos Michaelides, Matthias Seifert, Adrian Gottschlich, Natasha Samson, Lina Majed, Daria Briukhovetska, Donjetë Simnica, Viktoria Hartmann, Kathrin Gabriel, Sonia Cohen, Genevieve M. Boland, David Andreu-Sanz, Emanuele Carlini, Sophia Stock, Anne Holtermann, Philipp Jie Müller, Thaddäus Strzalkowski, Marcel P. Trefny, Stefan Endres, Russell W. Jenkins, Jan P. Böttcher, Sebastian Kobold
data.summary: Abstract The efficacy of chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy in solid cancers is limited by immunosuppression in the tumour microenvironment (TME). Prostaglandin E 2 (PGE 2 ) is a key factor locally inhibiting T cell function. We hypothesized that targeted ablation of PGE 2 signalling in CAR T cells may enhance their activity in PGE 2 -rich solid tumours. Here we generate knockout CAR T cells double deficient for the PGE 2 receptors EP2 and EP4 (EP2 −/− EP4 −/− ) by CRISPR–Cas9 engineering. EP2 −/− EP4 −/− CAR T cells expanded unabatedly in the presence of PGE 2 . Further, they effectively controlled syngeneic and human xenograft tumour models in vivo, which was accompanied by intratumoural accumulation and persistence of modified T cells. Improved anti-tumour activity was also observed against patient-derived tumour samples from patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), colorectal (CRC) and neuroendocrine (NET) cancer. Our data uncovers the detrimental impact of PGE 2 -mediated suppression on CAR T cell efficacy and highlights EP2 and EP4 targeting as a potential strategy.
data.title_cn: 通过 CAR T 细胞中的双受体敲除消除前列腺素 E2 信号传导可增强实体瘤的治疗效果
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 嵌合抗原受体 (CAR) T 细胞治疗实体癌的疗效受到肿瘤微环境 (TME) 中免疫抑制的限制。前列腺素E 2 (PGE 2 ) 是局部抑制T细胞功能的关键因素。我们假设，CAR T 细胞中 PGE 2 信号传导的靶向消除可能会增强其在富含 PGE 2 的实体瘤中的活性。在这里，我们通过 CRISPR-Cas9 工程产生了 PGE 2 受体 EP2 和 EP4 (EP2 −/− EP4 −/− ) 双缺陷的敲除 CAR T 细胞。 EP2 −/− EP4 −/− CAR T 细胞在 PGE 2 存在下有增无减。此外，他们在体内有效地控制了同基因和人类异种移植肿瘤模型，同时伴随着修饰T细胞的肿瘤内积累和持续存在。针对来自胰腺导管腺癌 (PDAC)、结直肠癌 (CRC) 和神经内分泌 (NET) 患者的患者来源的肿瘤样本，还观察到抗肿瘤活性有所改善。我们的数据揭示了 PGE 2 介导的抑制对 CAR T 细胞功效的不利影响，并强调 EP2 和 EP4 靶向作为一种潜在策略。
